package: SCITT statement identification: three signed statements and the references between them
reference_format: a protected header parameter, private-use label -70001, holding an array of [digest algorithm (COSE algorithm identifier), covered bytes (text), digest (bstr)]

references.covered_bytes: the Sig_structure ["Signature1", body_protected, external_aad, payload] of the referenced COSE_Sign1, encoded as RFC 9052 sections 4.4 and 9 specify; the protected value is the original byte-string contents; external_aad is the empty byte string and the payload is embedded
references.why_these_bytes: ToBeSigned excludes the signature, the unprotected header and the outer wrapper, so changes confined to those parts preserve it; it does not normalize the bytes inside the protected header or the payload. It names this class of signed inputs, not a particular signature instance. Matching it does not establish signature validity, payload truth, issuer trust or registration. A digest of the whole COSE_Sign1 bytes changes with any of those excluded parts.
